source: O*NET Interest Profiler Short Form (USDOL/ETA), Persian adaptation

items.note: Jazz or tap dance (public dance performance) is socially unsuitable in Iran; replaced with stage acting in theater, same Artistic type and performing-skill level. Back-translation differs by design (intended adaptation).

items.note: Beauty salon or barber shop merged into the natural Iranian pair of women's or men's salon (gender-segregated establishments).
